Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: The Green Valley Community Club is a community-oriented facility offering a range of recreational activities, including fitness classes such as yoga and Pilates, as well as organized social events. Our club promotes a safe and welcoming environment, prioritizing member engagement and wellness. We have implemented comprehensive safety protocols, including regular equipment maintenance, staff training programs, and member safety workshops. Additionally, we do not serve alcohol or food on the premises, reducing potential liability exposures. The club also hosts seasonal events for the community, fostering social interaction and healthy lifestyles.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, during a group yoga class, a member slipped on a wet mat and suffered a sprained wrist. The claim was filed for $2,000, and it is currently in review for approval. In addition, on 07/10/2022, a minor injury occurred when a participant tripped over a yoga block, resulting in a medical expense of $3,000. This claim has been settled, with the final amount paid being $2,500. Both incidents highlighted the need for improved monitoring during classes and resulted in the implementation of additional safety measures.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B safe, UL 768 rated, capacity 200 lbs, fire-resistant label.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing surrounding the property, 24/7 surveillance cameras, and a trained on-site security officer during all operational hours.
